C21 establishes the renumbered § 1622.23 framework but provides less displayed operative text.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"A registrant's employment in industry or other occupation, service in office, or activity in research, or medical, scientific, or other endeavors, shall be considered to be necessary ... only when all of the following conditions exist","parent_excerpt":"A registrant's employment in industry or other occupation, service in office, or activity in research, or medical, scientific, or other endeavors, shall be considered to be necessary ... only when all of the following conditions exist","explanation":"C25 and the child use essentially identical introductory language defining necessary employment."},{"child_excerpt":"(1) The registrant is, or but for a seasonal or temporary interruption would be, engaged in such activity. (3) The removal of the registrant would cause a material loss of effectiveness in such activity.","explanation":"The distinctive three-part cumulative test is reproduced verbatim."},{"child_excerpt":"The President may, from time to time (1) designate special categories of occupation, employment, or activity, essential to the national health, safety, or interest; and (2) prescribe regulations governing the deferment of individual registrants engaged in such occupations, employments, or activities.","parent_excerpt":"The President may, from time to time (1) designate special categories of occupation, employment, or activity essential to the national health, safety, or interest; and (2) prescribe regulations governing the deferment of individual registrants engaged in such occupations, employments, or activities.","explanation":"The child retains C25’s two-part presidential designation-and-regulation mechanism almost word for word."},{"child_excerpt":"(b) A registrant's activity as an apprentice in an apprentice training program may be considered ... when all of the following condition exist","parent_excerpt":"(b) A registrant's activity in study may be considered ... when any of the following conditions exist","explanation":"The child adapts C25’s paragraph structure for a specialized deferment category, substituting apprentice training for study and prescribing a new set of eligibility conditions."}]}
